# Isolde Pembroke & Opal Pettigrew

- [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) — Friend of — [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md) — old friends who gather together on Saturdays · since v2  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
- [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) — Comrade of — [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md) — former schoolmates · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Atonement” P10](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0010), [v3 ch.Summons P35](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0035)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde walk to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school together while discussing their schoolmates and their beautiful surroundings. During afternoon classes, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her hair, prompting an enraged [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to smash her slate over his head.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038)_

> In class, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her red hair, prompting her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md) punishes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by forcing her to stand at the front of the room and later making her sit beside Hugh, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to declare that she will never return to school. Upon returning home, [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) seeks advice from [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), who recommends letting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rest at home until her temper subsides.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

A Tempest in the School Teapot P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)_

> Isolde tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) they can no longer be friends on her mother's orders, and the two share an emotional farewell. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to school, where her classmates welcome her back and she exchanges secret notes with Isolde. She commits herself to her studies, entering an intense academic rivalry with [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) while struggling with geometry.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_

> While [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and Mrs. Sowerby attend a political rally in town, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) spend a quiet evening at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) rushes in to ask for help when her baby sister, [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md), contracts croup while their parents are away. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) uses her experience to treat [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md) through the night until a doctor arrives, saving the child's life before returning home to rest.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home on the last day of school, emotional over Mr. Pidgeon's departure and discussing the upcoming arrival of the new clergyman, Mr. [Wace](../character/wace.md), and his wife. She later discusses the church's new leadership, her Sunday school experiences, and her excitement about baking a cake for the new minister's visit, which she practices for while spending time with Isolde by the Nymph's Well.
>

> At a party hosted by [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accepts a dare from [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md) to walk across the kitchen roof's ridgepole. She slips and falls, breaking her ankle in the process. Mr. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) carries her home to [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends the next seven weeks recovering in bed while friends, neighbors, and local figures visit her.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to school under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md), and excitedly shares her academic achievements and upcoming school concert plans with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md). While [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) remains skeptical of the concert and physical activities, [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) offers [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) his steady support and encouragement.
>

> At [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md) offered to include her in a special class to prepare for the Regent's entrance exam. Excited by the chance to train as a teacher, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accepts and joins the class alongside her peers, though she mourns that Isolde will not be participating with her.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her classmates adjust to life at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) as exams approach, balancing academic rivalry and friendships. Meanwhile, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) continues visiting [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and maintains a positive perspective on her studies and upcoming examinations.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde talk in bed at night about local gossip, the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and Nell's upcoming departure for [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). They discuss romance, Nell's feelings about Hugh, and Opal Pettigrew's behavior, concluding with a heartfelt reaffirmation of their deep and lasting friendship.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh attend a farewell gathering hosted by the B.V.I.S., where they receive send-off gifts. After feeling discouraged by local opinions about her upcoming college attendance, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes for a walk through the woods with Hugh, finding a wild apple tree and enjoying a quiet walk home along [Linger Lane](../codex/places.md#linger-lane).
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P5](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0005), [v3 ch.Autumn P11](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0011), [v3 ch.Autumn P31](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0031)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) settle into college life at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), aided by Cressida Lindsay's social influence while [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) earns respect as Freshman Class president. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a stack of letters from home containing updates from [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and news from her friends and family, including humorous local stories from Mrs. Sowerby.
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007), [v3 ch.Home P10](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0010)_

> In bed on New Year's Eve, [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) proposes marriage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on behalf of her bashful brother, [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) firmly declines the proposal, causing [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) to react with cool indifference and note that [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) will likely marry [Nettie Scobie](../character/nettie-scobie.md) instead. After [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) leaves the next morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) laughs over the unromantic reality of her very first marriage proposal.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VIII Nell’s First Proposal

_Sources: [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 ch.Proposal P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 ch.Proposal P25](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0025)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and observes subtle changes around town, including [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) Pullen's marriage and Odette's plan to move West. She learns from Mrs. Sowerby that her friend [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md) is gravely ill with consumption. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde drop off jelly at Aunt Drusilla's home, enduring her unpleasant remarks before continuing on to visit Opal, while [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) confides her secret ambition to write a story.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XI The Round of Life

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 ch.Life P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v3 ch.Life P42](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0042)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) sits in the garden with Opal, who tearfully confesses her fear of dying and her unfulfilled desires for her life. Shortly after, Opal passes away peacefully in her sleep. Following the funeral, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) walk home discussing death and the afterlife.
>
